de: The leaders of seven EU states called for the suspension of visas for Russian and Belarusian athletes, including those admitted to competitions in neutral status.

de: Russian tourists can temporarily travel to Sri Lanka without obtaining an electronic entry permit (ETA). This was reported by the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR).

te: Three utilities received concussions during the attack of the AFU UAV on the garbage truck in Kakhovka
de: Three employees of the environmental operator of the Kherson region received concussions as a result of the attack of a Ukrainian drone on a garbage truck in Kakhovka. This was reported in the regional Ministry of Natural Resources.

de: In Russia, the court in absentia sentenced the commander of the special operations forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, Major Andrei Anikulaesey, to 24 years in prison for a terrorist attack in the Bryansk region. This is reported by the IC of Russia.

de: Academician of the Russian Academy of Sciences Gennady Onishchenko expressed the opinion that the spread of antibiotic-resistant bacteria Klebsiella pneumoniae should not be considered a new pandemic.

de: Two-time Olympic medalist in biathlon Kristina Reztsova said that she is increasingly inclined to leave the sport for the sake of children, although she still allows continued performances.

t: В Бангладеш десятки швейных фабрик приостановили работу из-за протестов

te: Dozens of Bangladeshi garment factories shut down due to protests
de: In Bangladesh, protests by garment workers demanding higher wages have led to clashes with police and the shutdown of dozens of factories, law enforcement officials said.

de: Konstantin Lebedev, a professor at the Department of International Business of the Financial University, said that in 2027, the subsidy for housing and communal services is planned to be extended after six months without re-submission of documents.
